$comment: AUTHORED per-channel visual decisions for the channels that had no Style Reference
Document. Everything here is chosen from that channel's OWN entry in
visual_spec.camera_angles and visual_spec.transitions -- and nothing is chosen from
general knowledge about the subject. scripts/build-visual-identity.js merges these
with the palette, font and pacing already in channels.json and writes
config/visual-identity.json plus one style reference document per channel.
ch-01, ch-02 and ch-09 are NOT here: they were curated by hand from real cited
external references and the builder leaves them exactly as they are.

ch-03.from: b_roll: screen recordings of AI tools, output comparisons, pricing page screenshots. cameras: screen capture primary, split-screen comparison, output zoom-in, pricing table.

ch-04.from: b_roll: archival footage, historical photographs, document animations, map territory changes, museum artifact footage. cameras: archival photo Ken Burns (a slow push with lateral drift), document zoom-in, map territory pan, artifact close-up.

ch-07.from: b_roll: stock market footage, office/corporate B-roll, product footage, news broadcasts, financial chart animations. cameras: corporate office wide, stock ticker close-up, product glamour shot, financial chart animation, news broadcast frame.
ch-07.curve_from: pacing: measured build to dramatic collapse

ch-11.from: b_roll: NASA public domain 4K, ESA imagery, James Webb Telescope CC images. cameras: orbital fly-through, planet close-up, galaxy wide, scale comparison zoom, star field tracking.

ch-17.from: b_roll: period paintings, archival maps, Google Earth historical, museum footage. cameras: painting Ken Burns, map territory pan, historical location drone (a high angle), artifact detail, timeline animation (a lateral track).
ch-17.curve_from: pacing: measured epic with dramatic peaks

ch-26.from: b_roll: SEC/FBI press footage, court documents, social media screenshots, blockchain explorers. cameras: document zoom-in, money trail animation, map fund movement (overhead), scam website walkthrough (static).
ch-26.curve_from: pacing: medium-slow with evidence breathing room

ch-30.from: b_roll: Othram/Parabon NanoLabs footage, DNA extraction animations, family tree visualizations. cameras: family photo Ken Burns, DNA animation, forensic lab wide, family tree overhead.
ch-30.curve_from: pacing: slow emotional, medium investigation, quick resolution

ch-31.from: b_roll: courtroom footage, prison stock, exoneree press conferences, Innocence Project archives. cameras: prison exterior, exoneree interview medium (static), courtroom wide, freedom moment, courthouse steps (low angle).
ch-31.curve_from: pacing: deliberate during injustice, quick exoneration, slow aftermath

ch-35.from: b_roll: custom 3D animations, data visualizations, real engineering footage, CAD models. cameras: 3D tech orbit (a lateral track), process flow, data visualization, scale comparison.

ch-39.from: b_roll: hospital stock footage, medical scans (CT, MRI), pharmaceutical imagery, lab footage. cameras: hospital hallway tracking, medical scan close-up, lab equipment, patient room medium, diagnostic data overlay.
ch-39.curve_from: pacing: slow diagnostic, fast treatment, reflective closing

ch-44.from: b_roll: custom vector illustrations (Kurzgesagt style), infographic animations, concept visualizations, diagram builds. cameras: concept animation, infographic build, data visualization, metaphor illustration.
ch-44.curve_from: pacing: fast but readable, pattern interrupts every 90-120 sec

ch-46.from: b_roll: stock corporate footage, text overlays, question/answer graphics. cameras: medium talking head equivalent, text question display, answer framework, pass/fail indicator.
ch-46.curve_from: pacing: steady, allows each tip to land

ch-47.from: b_roll: screen recordings of Medicare.gov, document/form visuals, comparison charts. cameras: screen capture Medicare.gov, comparison chart, document close-up, plan comparison split.
ch-47.curve_from: pacing: deliberate measured for senior audience

ch-48.from: b_roll: custom 3D from CAD files, factory drone footage, machine close-ups, process flow diagrams, component photography. cameras: 3D factory orbit, process flow overhead, machine cross-section, assembly line tracking.
